attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as root:root mode 1777 (world-writable with sticky bit), verified two distinct non-root users can each create files but cannot delete each other's files while retaining the ability to delete their own. Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed (real restart, not just downtime), and re-verified /srv/drop's permissions and cross-user delete-protection behavior post-restart.
